name: Enc
source:
The bully of the tank.

[spoiler]ALLEN's pessimistic side and the manifestation of his self-hatred and depression. His hatred towards Liam comes from the physical pain that forces Allen to eat a lot of pills that make him feel even worse.

Enc incarnated as The Hero Thief in Kingdom of Glass where RB inserted him and Liam to solve their relationship.[/spoiler]
